name: split-attn-gated
hypothesis: Profile (split-attn, 64-token prompt, --decode-detail): 4,146 us a token = 59 us host encoding + 3,281 us command GPU time + ~580 us from commit to GPU start + ~200 us from GPU end to the host waking; neither spinning on the status nor a completion handler shortens the wake, and back-to-back command buffers start 0.6 us apart. So commit token k+1's forward while token k runs, held by a one-thread GPU gate (mk_d2_gate_packed) that the host opens only after reading token k back and writing token k+1 (packed with a generation into the word the embedding reads, mk_d2_embed_gated); the host spins on the argmax word, which is visible ~2 us before GPUEndTime. Same kernels and arithmetic; the host still reads every token before the next forward starts. Expect decode +20% at 64 (to ~300) and +12% at 4,096 (~270); one extra launch a token.
